headline: Central Bank of Nigeria Grants JPMorgan Merchant Bank Approval
summary: The Central Bank of Nigeria issued approval-in-principle for JPMorgan to establish a merchant bank in the country, marking an essential preliminary stage toward securing a final banking operating licence.
why: JPMorgan is the largest US lender by assets. Expanding its footprint in Africa's most populous economy signals growing interest in Nigerian wholesale and corporate finance.

impacts.name: JPMorgan Chase & Co.
impacts.why: Establishing a merchant bank expands wholesale investment banking reach in Nigeria.
